articles.title: A WW1 Submarine Wreck Is Leaking Explosives Into The North Sea
articles.summary: A German WW1 submarine, SM UC-30, sank in April 1917 after hitting a British mine while returning home. The incident resulted in the loss of 27 crewmen along with its armament of 18 mines and six torpedoes. This historical event underscores the inherent dangers and strategic importance of naval warfare during major conflicts.
